data.keyword: What's the best HR software for a small company?

result.keyword: What's the best HR software for a small company?
result.markdown:
For most small businesses, I'd recommend **Gusto** if you want payroll and HR in one easy-to-use system. However, if you're looking for a more complete HR management platform, **BambooHR** may be the better choice.

The best option depends on whether you primarily need payroll, employee management, onboarding, benefits, or broader HR functions.

## My top 5 HR software recommendations

![Gusto: The all-in-one people platform for payroll, benefits, HR | Product Hunt](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/U9ihkiZChKRcgqjjRClvDRyT9XG9-GpMyinllUWob9alMftBmPGRcobY-YvDUQKw1cvVb4T3cEeJpN5ErI9IqBVMrrh8CobtTNAx_DYMZG5QgeYUTUHnLdeuUVTXGf9kQQbmuo-8rs3UnMu94W26KU8QJR6ha5lcvmllFK9LSsVoa23KAvlPVkN4pktlksyv?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Gusto**

(Best overall for small businesses)

- Payroll processing and tax filing
- Employee onboarding and document management
- Benefits administration
- PTO and time tracking

**Starting price\:** Approximately \$49/month + \$6/employee/month.

Website: [Gusto](https://gusto.com/)

---

![Free High-Quality Bamboohr Logo for Creative Design](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/NdLSBGjy-t4LAE90fgF-ddR4i37sUJnkP2I2etLyMCzK30ZNnDLeOFNkJ4ONgornqI4dpQO60O7vJzcBWlKGYP0PmgOwkcxyOEu4BL3JtyYZ8ZsdTCrW5IgVGOXAbKINwLVIP8GRxZkWvj639AwhCvO-Z0MW5ibDEnj4uSEouHdZBnZYXe0Ke7Brv94puUyT?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. BambooHR**

(Best dedicated HR platform)

- Centralized employee records
- Hiring and onboarding
- Performance reviews
- PTO management
- HR reporting and employee self-service

**Starting price\:** Around \$10/employee/month, with a \$250/month starting price for companies with 25 or fewer employees.

Website: [BambooHR](https://www.bamboohr.com/)

---

![#1 Workforce Management System - Gong Collective](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/6qeGsApk2jIdFyoxTSygvm7DexVcRwsdAMy-654nhQtsS9qblmlI3_rlyRsZYYkAZppbxudJa7sWDHqPbmVa4ApGBm0HQ-Ug4zK3bKSWGz9BUa-Xw79ufdKKevGKKSwz6wXnJf7tmhQAv7jp_2IhhmpGMf4r2A4gxIyk--T1g2YbjSd8UAKymDETIYyyT6m-?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Rippling**

(Best for automation and growth)

- HR, payroll and benefits
- Employee onboarding and offboarding
- IT account and device management
- Automated workflows

**Starting price\:** Approximately \$8/employee/month plus a base fee; actual pricing depends on modules.

Website: [Rippling](https://www.rippling.com/)

---

![Introducing Zoho People 5.0 | Streamlined & secure HR software](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/N2tyoCYDXo_2X8HD_5-SWCfDBpBrfnJxvS27zq0luRDcSBxvb5ksF8GIcSrns-PjyFB81AcM6r9iE-CSXiUONYeUFYVq66I46rVVwsJXPLlWkRDDpj17x51dneUMDGMOeIbB1fDSAq7EtcK5moqwY1sb0xYonWwdnsoigFpIV0zzd1uQR8FzhmzsLBPdP8qA?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Zoho People**

(Best budget option)

- Employee database
- Attendance and time tracking
- Leave management
- Performance management

**Starting price\:** Free entry-level plan; paid plans start around \$1.50/user/month.

Website: [Zoho People](https://www.zoho.com/people/)

---

![Homebase Reviews | Read Customer Service Reviews of joinhomebase.com](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/ONPs31_XAP2XsJBs3Eie1qwgyuurZU2xtkB45n63IU2mOmCOoAYejKgqUNvwLJpQL-m8_ulLsnIwjUgfiI4WF5j-tZkBh8f6GZwUhD2ecILOo9YLaThDdn8foDqSv6GukdJX7e1Y6DGttWLJtIJKBrbS-cL872eVJQ2r8lUE_O-eo573PPEMZiZEhnAyfs0F?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. Homebase**

(Best for hourly employees)

- Employee scheduling
- Time clocks and attendance
- Timesheets
- Labor cost management

**Starting price\:** Free basic plan; paid plans available.

Website: [Homebase](https://www.joinhomebase.com/)

Pricing is approximate and subject to plan, employee count, add-ons and billing terms. Sources: [zapier.com](https://zapier.com/blog/best-hr-software-for-small-businesses/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[technologyadvice.com](https://technologyadvice.com/blog/human-resources/best-hr-software-for-small-business/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.itechguides.com](https://www.itechguides.com/best-hris-for-small-businesses-in-2026-6-practical-picks/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## Which one would I choose?

| Your priority | My recommendation |
|--------|--------|
| Payroll + HR together | Gusto |
| Complete HR management | BambooHR |
| HR + IT automation | Rippling |
| Lowest cost | Zoho People |
| Scheduling hourly workers | Homebase |
